title: Title
description: Allergy Travel Scanner — Eat safely in any language.
speakerNotes:
Hi — I'm here with Allergy Travel Scanner.

- For travelers with food allergies, every foreign menu is a guessing game.
- We turn your phone into a calm, instant translator that knows your allergies.
- Tagline: eat safely in any language.

title: Problem
description: Foreign menus put 32M Americans with allergies at real risk.
speakerNotes:
Set the stakes.

- 32 million Americans live with food allergies.
- Every year, 200,000 end up in the ER for severe reactions.
- Abroad, the menu is in a language they can't read — there's no tool today that screens it the way an allergist would.

title: Solution
description: Point your phone at a menu and every dish gets a colored risk pin.
speakerNotes:
One-line pitch.

- Hold up the camera; we read the menu in any language.
- Each dish gets a pin: green for safe, amber for caution, red for avoid.
- Tap any dish for a plain-English explanation grounded in your allergy profile.

title: Demo
description: Hand-off slide for the live product demo.
speakerNotes:
Hand off to the live demo here.

- I'll switch to the running app and scan a real Spanish tapas menu against my allergy profile.
- Three things to watch for: scan, explain, order.
- Come back to the deck after the demo.

title: How it works
description: Camera, then Gemini plus knowledge graph, then explainable risk pins.
speakerNotes:
Three steps under the hood.

- The camera and OCR isolate dish names and ingredient hints.
- Gemini 2.0 Flash translates and walks our ingredient knowledge graph for hidden allergens and contamination.
- The output is a colored pin with a citation chain — never a black-box answer.

title: What's unique
description: Citation chains, cross-contamination engine, personalized risk, show-the-waiter mode.
speakerNotes:
Why this isn't just a translator.

- Citation chains: every verdict shows the ingredient, source, and rule behind it.
- A cross-contamination engine flags shared fryers and kitchen practices.
- A personalized risk model learns your tolerance over time.
- Show-the-waiter mode hands the kitchen a translated allergy card.

title: Tech stack
description: Gemini 2.0 Flash, 100k+ ingredient graph, SSE streaming, React + Capacitor, ML scoring.
speakerNotes:
Built for explainability, not just speed.

- Gemini 2.0 Flash for multimodal reading and translation.
- A 100,000-plus node ingredient knowledge graph.
- SSE streaming so dishes appear as they're analyzed.
- React plus Capacitor for one codebase across web and native; ML scoring per user.

title: Impact & vision
description: Who it helps today and where it's going next.
speakerNotes:
Who this is for and where it goes.

- Today: 32 million people in the US, plus anyone traveling abroad with dietary restrictions.
- Next: native iOS and Android, twelve more languages, and a memory of trusted restaurants.
- The goal is making eating abroad feel like second nature.

title: Thank you
description: Closing slide with demo URL placeholder and Q&A invitation.
speakerNotes:
Close and open it up.

- Thank you — try the live demo at allergy.travel or scan the QR.
- Happy to take questions, especially the hard ones.
- Eat safely in any language.
